title: Cypress
description: An end-to-end testing framework for web applications.

data.text: Cypress is an end-to-end testing framework that runs in the browser. It provides a time-traveling debugger, automatic waiting, and a developer-friendly UI for writing and debugging tests.

data.title: Cypress Test Example
data.content: Write a simple E2E test for a login form.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Cypress runs directly in the browser
data.takeaway: Cypress makes E2E testing accessible with excellent developer experience.
